'''Vos Gesal Street''' was a street in the [[Uscru Entertainment District]] of [[Coruscant]], along which the [[Outlander Club]] was located. It was named after the [[Vos Gesal family]] and became a favorite place for singers, [[musician]]s, [[artist]]s and entertainers.<ref name="CL" />
